lines.zh: 我在冰层下面游，水冷得发蓝。
lines.en: I swim beneath the ice, through water blue with cold.

lines.zh: 背鳍划开水面，留下一道细纹。
lines.en: My dorsal fin splits the surface, leaving a thin line.

lines.zh: 这片冻海是我的地盘，别下水。
lines.en: This frozen sea is mine; do not come in.

lines.zh: 我贴着海床游，捡些碎贝壳。
lines.en: I skim the sea floor, picking at broken shells.

lines.zh: 冰洞口太小，我得侧着身子。
lines.en: The ice hole is small; I must turn sideways.

lines.zh: 一群同类在前面，我跟上去。
lines.en: A school of my kind is ahead; I join them.

lines.zh: 冷水让我游得慢，也游得久。
lines.en: Cold water makes me slow, and makes me last.

lines.zh: 我从冰柱缝里钻过去，鳍没碰着。
lines.en: I slip between ice pillars without touching a fin.

lines.zh: 水底的沙很细，一碰就浑了。
lines.en: The bottom sand is fine and clouds at a touch.

lines.zh: 我摆尾的力气，只够游这么远。
lines.en: One flick of my tail carries me just this far.

lines.zh: 上面有块亮，那是冰的裂口。
lines.en: That brightness above is a crack in the ice.

lines.zh: 我绕开那些海带，刺会缠住。
lines.en: I steer around the kelp; my spines snag on it.

lines.zh: 冰水灌进鳃里，倒挺舒服。
lines.en: Icy water through my gills feels good.

lines.zh: 我游得不快，可从不迷路。
lines.en: I am not fast, but I never lose the way.

lines.zh: 我绕过那根冰柱，刺差点碰上。
lines.en: I round the ice pillar, spines nearly scraping.

lines.zh: 光线从冰缝漏下来，我躲开。
lines.en: Light leaks through the ice crack; I slide away.

lines.zh: 水冷得骨头响，我照样往前。
lines.en: The cold makes my bones creak. I still go on.

lines.zh: 沉船的木板在左边，我游过去。
lines.en: Planks of a wreck lie left. I swim over.

lines.zh: 我停在水草边，让鳃慢慢动。
lines.en: I hover by the weeds and let my gills move slowly.

lines.zh: 冰面透下的光，在我背上晃。
lines.en: Light through the ice wavers on my back.

lines.zh: 泡在水里，连心跳都变慢了。
lines.en: In the water, even my heartbeat slows.

lines.zh: 我背上的刺竖着，不是吓你。
lines.en: My spines stand up, and not to scare you.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼游过去，我没去追。
lines.en: A small fish passes; I do not chase it.

lines.zh: 桶里的水一晃，我就转个圈。
lines.en: When the bucket water sloshes, I turn a circle.

lines.zh: 冻海很静，只有冰在响。
lines.en: The frozen sea is quiet except for the ice cracking.

lines.zh: 我嘴里含着一口水，慢慢吐出去。
lines.en: I hold a mouthful of water and let it out slowly.

lines.zh: 那片海带好厚，钻进去正合适。
lines.en: That kelp is thick; a good place to tuck into.

lines.zh: 我等潮水带来一点吃的。
lines.en: I wait for the current to bring me something to eat.

lines.zh: 我的鳞是灰的，冰下看不出来。
lines.en: My scales are grey and vanish under the ice.

lines.zh: 有只海豹在上面走，我沉下去。
lines.en: A seal walks above; I sink lower.

lines.zh: 棘鱼不爱叫，尾巴会响。
lines.en: Spinefish seldom call; my tail does the talking.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让冰水冲过鳃。
lines.en: I turn and let the cold current wash my gills.

lines.zh: 你蹲在冰洞口，挡住我的光了。
lines.en: You crouch at the ice hole and block my light.

lines.zh: 你的脸贴得太近，我看花了。
lines.en: Your face is too close; my eyes blur.

lines.zh: 把手伸进来，我就扎你一下。
lines.en: Reach in, and I will prick your hand once.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味，隔着水都闻得到。
lines.en: I smell the iron on you even through the water.

lines.zh: 我从水下抬头，看你的倒影。
lines.en: I look up from below at your reflection.

lines.zh: 你不是鱼，为什么泡在水里。
lines.en: You are not a fish; why are you in the water?

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在两侧，转不过来。
lines.en: My eyes sit on both sides; I cannot turn them.

lines.zh: 你拿桶做什么，我认得那东西。
lines.en: What is that bucket for? I know that thing.

lines.zh: 水面上的脸晃得厉害，我看不清。
lines.en: Your face wavers on the surface; I cannot see it.

lines.zh: 你退开半步，我就游近一点。
lines.en: Step back half a pace, and I will swim a little closer.

lines.zh: 我的鳞翻起一片，水有点红。
lines.en: A scale lifts and the water turns faintly red.

lines.zh: 刺断了一根，长回来要好些天。
lines.en: One spine broke; it will take days to grow back.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我鳃都合不上。
lines.en: That blow knocked my gills shut.

lines.zh: 我窜出去老远，才敢回头看。
lines.en: I dart far away before I dare look back.

lines.zh: 水下没处躲，我贴着冰底。
lines.en: Nowhere to hide below; I press against the ice floor.

lines.zh: 疼是疼，我还能游。
lines.en: It hurts, but I can still swim.

lines.zh: 谁碰了我的背鳍，我记住了。
lines.en: Whoever touched my dorsal fin, I remember.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，肚皮朝上又翻回来。
lines.en: I flip belly-up, then right myself.

lines.zh: 水花乱了，我的群也散了。
lines.en: The water churns and my school scatters.

lines.zh: 你下手不轻，我得躲几天。
lines.en: You hit hard; I will keep out of sight for days.

lines.zh: 你撒下的碎屑，我闻见了。
lines.en: I smell the crumbs you scattered.

lines.zh: 虫子挂在钩上，我不咬钩。
lines.en: A worm hangs on a hook; I will not bite the hook.

lines.zh: 别用面包屑引我，太浅了。
lines.en: Do not lure me with bread crumbs; that is too shallow.

lines.zh: 那块碎肉沉下来了，我等着。
lines.en: That scrap of meat is sinking; I wait for it.

lines.zh: 我游近看看，只是看看。
lines.en: I swim close to look — only to look.

lines.zh: 你手里晃的东西，像条小鱼。
lines.en: The thing you dangle looks like a small fish.

lines.zh: 我不抢食，我等它自己沉底。
lines.en: I do not snatch; I wait for it to settle.

lines.zh: 冰下的味道传得慢，我得多闻闻。
lines.en: Smells travel slowly under ice; let me sniff more.

lines.zh: 你要是把桶放低，我可能进去。
lines.en: Lower that bucket, and I might go in.

lines.zh: 这些诱饵太新，我有点疑心。
lines.en: This bait is too fresh; I am a little suspicious.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，撞散了我的群。
lines.en: You stepped into the water and broke up my school.

lines.zh: 我的刺挂住你的裤脚，扯掉了。
lines.en: My spines snag your trouser leg and tear it.

lines.zh: 你踢到我了，水花溅了一身。
lines.en: You kicked me; water sprays everywhere.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的靴子，弹回水里。
lines.en: I bump your boot and bounce back into the water.

lines.zh: 你走得太急，把冰踩塌了。
lines.en: You walked too fast and broke the ice.

lines.zh: 冰洞口挤，我们撞在一起。
lines.en: The ice hole is narrow; we bump into each other.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫到你，滑得很。
lines.en: My tail brushes you, slippery as it is.

lines.zh: 桶沿磕到我，我翻了个身。
lines.en: The bucket rim knocks me and I flip over.

lines.zh: 你身上滴的水，正好落我头上。
lines.en: The water dripping off you lands on my head.

lines.zh: 让开一点，你占了整条水道。
lines.en: Move aside; you are blocking the whole channel.

lines.zh: 春天水暖一点，我就找同伴。
lines.en: When the water warms in spring, I look for a mate.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，鳍碰着鳍。
lines.en: We swim side by side, fin against fin.

lines.zh: 冰下的水太冷，得游快点。
lines.en: The water under the ice is cold; we must swim faster.

lines.zh: 她的刺比我短，颜色更浅。
lines.en: Her spines are shorter than mine and paler.

lines.zh: 我们在海草里绕圈，水都浑了。
lines.en: We circle in the seagrass until the water clouds.

lines.zh: 一窝卵要藏在石头下面。
lines.en: A clutch of eggs must hide beneath the stones.

lines.zh: 我把最干净的沙让给她。
lines.en: I give her the cleanest patch of sand.

lines.zh: 同类太多了，得挑个安静的。
lines.en: Too many of my kind; I want a quiet one.

lines.zh: 她不看我，我就再绕一圈。
lines.en: She will not look at me, so I circle once more.

lines.zh: 产完卵，我们各自游开。
lines.en: Once the eggs are laid, we swim our separate ways.

lines.zh: 我嘴里只能含一口水。
lines.en: A mouthful of water is all my mouth can hold.

lines.zh: 掉了东西在水底，我也搬不动。
lines.en: Whatever falls to the bottom, I cannot move it.

lines.zh: 你用桶捞我，比用手快。
lines.en: Scooping me with a bucket is faster than hands.

lines.zh: 那枚铁钉沉下来，我没去动。
lines.en: That iron nail sinks; I leave it alone.

lines.zh: 水里的东西会漂走，我追不上。
lines.en: Things drift away in water; I cannot keep up.

lines.zh: 我的鳍不是手，抓不住什么。
lines.en: Fins are not hands; I cannot grasp anything.

lines.zh: 桶底有块石头，你放进去的？
lines.en: There is a stone in the bucket — did you put it there?

lines.zh: 你要是掉了镐，自己下水捡。
lines.en: If you drop your pick, go in and get it.

lines.zh: 我只带走水草里的一点沙。
lines.en: All I carry off is a bit of sand from the weeds.

lines.zh: 别把东西丢进我的水洞。
lines.en: Do not throw things into my water hole.

lines.zh: 你踹了冰面，鱼群全乱了。
lines.en: You kicked the ice and scattered the whole school.

lines.zh: 你抓走我同伴，我记住了。
lines.en: You took my schoolmate; I remember it.

lines.zh: 谁在往水里倒东西，站住。
lines.en: Whoever is pouring something into the water, stop.

lines.zh: 我不爱斗，可你踩到卵了。
lines.en: I do not fight, but you stepped on the eggs.

lines.zh: 那条钩线又来了，我盯上它。
lines.en: That fishing line is back; I am watching it.

lines.zh: 你把水搅浑，我找不到路了。
lines.en: You have muddied the water and I cannot find my way.

lines.zh: 我的刺不是摆设，你逼的。
lines.en: My spines are not decoration; you forced this.

lines.zh: 冰洞口被人堵住，我得冲。
lines.en: Someone blocked the ice hole; I must charge.

lines.zh: 同伴在那边翻白，我过去了。
lines.en: A schoolmate is floating pale over there; I go.

lines.zh: 你一伸手，我就当你要抓我。
lines.en: When you reach out, I take it as a grab.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，找你的脚踝。
lines.en: I circle you, looking for your ankle.

lines.zh: 水是我的，你站的地方太深了。
lines.en: This water is mine, and you are standing too deep.

lines.zh: 我把刺对着你，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I level my spines at you and close in slowly.

lines.zh: 你后退，水就替你挡一下。
lines.en: As you retreat, the water covers for you.

lines.zh: 我不叫，只是尾巴摆得快。
lines.en: I make no sound; my tail just beats faster.

lines.zh: 冰下很暗，你找不着我。
lines.en: Under the ice it is dark; you will not find me.

lines.zh: 你踩水的动静太大了。
lines.en: The noise you make wading is far too loud.

lines.zh: 我从你脚边擦过去，试试深浅。
lines.en: I graze past your feet to test the depth.

lines.zh: 你要是退到岸上，我就停。
lines.en: If you back onto land, I will stop.

lines.zh: 我的刺全竖起来了，看清楚了。
lines.en: Every spine of mine is up; look closely.

lines.zh: 我一甩身，刺划过你的手背。
lines.en: I whip around and my spines rake your hand.

lines.zh: 这一下只够划破皮，够了。
lines.en: That only broke the skin — enough.

lines.zh: 我从水下顶你的膝盖。
lines.en: I butt your knee from under the water.

lines.zh: 刺扎进靴缝里，你得拔一会。
lines.en: A spine lodges in your boot seam; you will be a while.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，就往深处钻。
lines.en: I strike once and dive for the deep.

lines.zh: 你抓我，先尝尝掌心的刺。
lines.en: Grab me and taste the spines in your palm.

lines.zh: 水花一起，你就看不见我了。
lines.en: When the spray rises, you lose sight of me.

lines.zh: 我不咬，扎一下就够。
lines.en: I do not bite; one prick will do.

lines.zh: 尾巴抽在你小腿上，很脆。
lines.en: My tail cracks against your calf.

lines.zh: 你再伸手，我还扎同一处。
lines.en: Reach again, and I prick the same spot.

lines.zh: 冰化开一条缝，我从底下钻出。
lines.en: A seam opens in the ice and I slip up through it.

lines.zh: 这片冻海还没有鱼，我先到。
lines.en: This frozen sea had no fish; I am first here.

lines.zh: 水很凉，正好合我的脾气。
lines.en: The water is cold, just to my temper.

lines.zh: 我被倒进桶里，又倒回海里。
lines.en: I was poured into a bucket and poured back into the sea.

lines.zh: 周围全是冰，我认得这地方。
lines.en: Ice on every side; I know this place.

lines.zh: 鳃一动，我就知道水是活的。
lines.en: One move of my gills tells me the water is alive.

lines.zh: 一群同类在远处，我游过去。
lines.en: A school is far off; I swim toward it.

lines.zh: 我的刺刚长硬，别碰。
lines.en: My spines have just hardened; do not touch them.

lines.zh: 海草晃了一下，那是我来了。
lines.en: The seagrass stirs — that is my arrival.

lines.zh: 冰下没有光，我正好藏身。
lines.en: No light under the ice; a fine place to hide.

lines.zh: 热水烫得我鳃发紧，我往下沉。
lines.en: Hot water tightens my gills; I sink lower.

lines.zh: 我被甩到冰面上，蹦不回水里。
lines.en: I am flung onto the ice and cannot bounce back.

lines.zh: 水明明是我的家，我却喘不上气。
lines.en: Water is my home, yet I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 水底一震，我的刺全震麻了。
lines.en: The blast shakes the bottom and stuns my spines.

lines.zh: 一支箭射穿水面，擦过我的背。
lines.en: An arrow pierces the surface and grazes my back.

lines.zh: 水里泛起紫光，我的鳞立起来。
lines.en: Violet light spreads in the water and my scales rise.

lines.zh: 冻海里吃的少，我瘦得见骨。
lines.en: Food is scarce in the frozen sea; I grow thin.

lines.zh: 雷落进水里，我全身一颤。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and my whole body jolts.

lines.zh: 水突然没了，我在空中乱摆。
lines.en: The water is gone; I thrash in empty air.
